title: Digital twin end to end: a simulated stream with a truth, and a real gauge
description: The heated-channel twin (two sensors, fouling conductance, known drift and spike) scored against its truth, and the same workflow on a linear reservoir commissioned on a live USGS gauge, with the drift verdict of pinneapple_analysis.trust on the residuals.

metrics.name: simulated.twin.nis_consistent
metrics.how: before the drift: mean NIS 2.21 over 129 readings, 95 % chi-square band [1.67, 2.36] (258 dof over the window)

metrics.name: simulated.twin.nis_after_recalibration
metrics.how: after the recalibration: mean NIS 1.67 over 97 readings, 95 % chi-square band [1.62, 2.42] (194 dof over the window)

metrics.name: simulated.twin.nees_consistent
metrics.how: NEES of the states and log parameters, 20 independent plants (truth known), averaged over the runs at each of 130 steps: 97% of the steps inside the 95 % band [2.02, 4.16] (3 dof; >= 85 %); mean 3.06

metrics.name: simulated.twin.drift_detected
metrics.how: drift of H at step 150 detected at step 152 (delay 2 steps, <= 20); in-control ARL of the CUSUM 9.56e+03 steps

metrics.name: simulated.twin.recalibrated
metrics.how: inverse workflow on steps 153-202: H = 27.762 (95 % [24.69, 31.216]) against the true 28 (0.85%); its checks pass

metrics.name: simulated.twin.anomaly_flagged
metrics.how: injected spike of 12 sigma at step 90: flagged; 2 other readings flagged at |z| > 4

metrics.name: simulated.twin.forecast_coverage
metrics.how: 60-step forecast: 88% of the withheld readings inside the 90 % interval (|coverage - 90 %| <= 13%, readings are correlated); RMSE 0.163

metrics.name: river.twin.nis_consistent
metrics.how: before the first alarm: mean NIS 0.859 over 1979 readings, 95 % chi-square band [0.939, 1.06] (1979 dof over the window)

metrics.name: river.twin.missing_readings
metrics.how: 4 incomplete reading(s) (4 with no sensor reporting) on Q: the twin forecast across them, assimilated nothing and kept a finite state
